latestMouthResearchStatus: r220 confirms that r210 already hides the legacy Lip_Upper, Lip_Lower and Mouth_WetLine shells, so the formal mouth is the continuous 41,692-vertex body surface. r221-r223 show that simple displacement and color cannot resolve the flat upper vermilion. r224 exposes triangle-shaped POINT-color interpolation boundaries. r225 produces a swollen ridge instead of a natural lip plane. r226 proves local subdivision can add 5,805 vertices while preserving all 21 armature groups and zero unweighted points, but its rectangular boundary creates visible commissure and nasolabial shading dents. latestHairScalpCandidateStatus: r163 derives a clean scalp shell from the same shaped body surface, copies all 21 skin-weight groups and Armature deformation, excludes the concave temple crease, and keeps 1.2mm authored clearance. Its 2,626 vertices/2,438 faces and r162 177,353-point pruned curly layer pass frame 1/20 collision checks against body and all three clothing solids. It reduces crown exposure but still fails strict overall hair appearance, so it is a scalp deformation/collision technical candidate only.
latestFoundationCandidateStatus: r249-r251 establish the rigged CC0 body foundation. r252 replaces stretched Generated-coordinate skin noise with isotropic object-space tone and pore fields and adds separate cornea layers. r253 corrects distorted cylinder-cap iris UVs with explicit radial UVs and reduces oversized catchlights. r254 and r255 are strict visual rejects for comb-like and parallel-line brows. r256 rebuilds 406 short stochastic eyebrow fibers per side plus clustered upper/lower lashes. Strict overall face quality is about 55/100, so it remains a technical candidate.
